x-nestor.title: Character
x-nestor.help: Who the assistant is and how it speaks, in its own words.

x-nestor.title: Language
x-nestor.help: The household's language (BCP 47, e.g. fr-FR): fixed phrases and the admin's default.

x-nestor.title: Accounts on channels
x-nestor.help: The accounts channels recognise this person by: telegram:123456789. Satellites need none: anyone in the room can talk to them.

agent.description:
Which model of `models` answers in each medium. One left out takes the other's; with a single
model, neither needs saying.

x-nestor.title: Spoken model
x-nestor.help: Answers aloud; the voice starts on its first sentence. Without one, the written model speaks too.

x-nestor.title: Written model
x-nestor.help: Answers in writing. Without one, the spoken model writes too.

agent.title: AgentConfig

watches.description: The model that sorts incoming items for the watches: the agent's written one by default.

x-nestor.title: Sorting model
x-nestor.help: Decides which watches each incoming item concerns. The written model by default.

watches.title: WatchesConfig

x-nestor.title: New conversation after (seconds)
x-nestor.help: A message sent this long after the last turn starts a new conversation: the assistant no longer replays the earlier turns. Memories stay.

x-nestor.title: Quiet hours
x-nestor.help: For example 22:30-07:30: nothing is said aloud then, unless urgent.

admin.description:
The admin web interface; without this section, Nestor serves none. Who may sign in is not
configured here: accounts live in the database (`nestor init`, `nestor accounts create-owner`).

x-nestor.title: Public address
x-nestor.help: How the household's browsers reach the admin, e.g. https://nestor.example.org.

admin.title: AdminConfig

updates.description:
Whether Nestor reads its release feed to tell the admin about newer releases. It never installs
anything: the household updates the way it installed Nestor.

x-nestor.title: Check for new releases
x-nestor.help: Once a day, Nestor reads its release feed and the admin says when a newer release is out. Nothing is installed.

x-nestor.title: Release feed
x-nestor.help: Where the list of releases is read from.

updates.title: UpdatesConfig

x-nestor.title: Data folder
x-nestor.help: Where the database, the vault and the configuration history live.

openai-compatible.description: Configuration of an OpenAI-compatible model; `api_key` should come from the environment.

x-nestor.title: Extra request fields
x-nestor.help: Sent as is with every request, e.g. the provider's routing options.

openai-compatible.title: OpenAICompatibleSettings

x-nestor.title: Language
x-nestor.help: The language spoken to the assistant, for transcription (e.g. fr).

VoiceSettings.description: How satellites allowed audio are heard and answered aloud (needs the `voice` extra).

x-nestor.title: Fallback clips folder
x-nestor.help: stt.wav and tts.wav, played when transcription or synthesis is down.

Never claim an action you did not perform.
